digest.component_or_area: Gerrit review bot, code-review project criterion
propositions: The review-phase-boundaries criterion must be validated live against the deployed Gerrit review bot's webhook-to-checkout-to-prompt path, not via offline replay, to prove end-to-end project-criterion execution.

A four-patchset advisory-only dogfood probe on a single Gerrit change must collect a positive-control discovery/evidence refinement, a historical severity-only stimulus baseline, a predeclared RP-F2 balanced-corpus FIRE control, and a final cleaned revision for submission to main.

The project-attributed advisory finding from the RP-F2 FIRE patchset must carry reviewer_id=code-review-project-review-phase-boundaries, criteria=[project.review-phase-boundaries], Pass-2 validity/impact observations, and Pass-3 decision=advisory with block_threshold=0.90 and blocking_enabled=false.
Blocking remains disabled throughout the dogfood (blocking_enabled=false, block_threshold=0.90 inert); threshold calibration and blocking promotion require a separate production-data-backed ticket.

The cleaned final patchset containing only valid phase-compliant review instructions must be the sole probe revision submitted to main, with all negative directives removed and no project-criterion finding emitted.
